results.summary_before: The PWM signal is generated by the temperature sensor, and this module is designed to count the number of clock cycles during which the PWM signal remains LOW. The design operates at 50 MHz and is notable for its simple PWM-to-UART conversion for temperature sensing. It measures the duty cycle of the PWM signal to determine temperature. The result is sent over a UART interface for external monitoring.
results.summary: This project bridges a parallel AXI-Stream interface with a serial UART communication protocol. Data is received from an AXI master, stored in an 8-byte synchronous FIFO, then serialized and transmitted over UART at 115200 baud. A loopback UART receiver is integrated to validate data integrity, and the design operates at 50 MHz. No external hardware is necessary to verify core functionality because the project is fully testable on-chip using the internal UART loopback.
